label: SB-12 idle-connection scale: RSS per connection at 1k/10k/100k
methodology: one fresh server per ladder point; one discarded full-N warmup open/close round, then 3 measured repeats: settle, baseline RSS (median of samples), open N TCP+HTTP/2 connections (client preface + server SETTINGS ACK, held idle, no RPCs), settle, loaded RSS; bytes/conn = (loaded-baseline)/established. Claim figure is the slope across ladder points. Cell order is frozen: peers in file order x ladder ascending.
idle_definition: TCP established + (plaintext) HTTP/2 preface complete + server SETTINGS received; the opener holds the socket with no PING ACKs, so the settle+measure window must stay below any peer keepalive enforcement (default >= 20 s everywhere; window is ~10 s).
claim_host_requirements: Linux, pinned server CPU, RLIMIT_NOFILE >= 200256, fs.file-max headroom. The 100k point needs multiple source addresses or destination address/port tuples; a single tuple cannot exceed 65,535 source ports. Current single-endpoint opener blocks it.

required_100k_topology.status: requires multi-address opener and recorded route/source binding; not yet executed

os_limit_policy: fd/port/backlog exhaustion (preflight budget, EMFILE/ENFILE/ENOBUFS/ENOMEM, refused-with-live-server, server-stderr fd notes, <99% established) marks the cell invalid, never fail; only fail exits nonzero.
